about: Golden dataset for the scraper review pipeline, built 2026-11-01 from the owner's approve/reject decisions in D1 pending_events (2,300 decisions, 660 distinct source+title groups). One case per source+title, using the most recent decision; n = how many times that title was reviewed with this outcome. expect: keep = owner approved, drop = owner rejected for content (not_for_kids, not_relevant, placeholder/garbled, unusable time). Rows rejected only for wrong_details/duplicate/bad_link on an otherwise-good title, verification flags (Possibly cancelled / Time changed), and early rejections with no reason are left out because they can't be judged from the candidate alone. Add a case whenever you reject something new for a content reason.

Old times aren't stored after an accepted time change, so start_time is the time on the flag.
